name: @dsh-ext/mobile-gateway
description: Mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: pinned-TLS WSS listener on loopback by default, per-device tokens with scoped pairing, live session sync, approval relay and file transfer. Cloudflare Tunnel, the cloudflared download and the one-command public setup are hard-disabled in v1.
